import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { employee } from "./employee";
import { invoice } from "./invoice";

export const customer = defineTable("customer", {
    columns: {
        customerId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        firstName: col.varchar({ length: 40 }).notNull(),
        lastName: col.varchar({ length: 20 }).notNull(),
        company: col.varchar({ length: 80 }),
        address: col.varchar({ length: 70 }),
        city: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        state: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        country: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        postalCode: col.varchar({ length: 10 }),
        phone: col.varchar({ length: 24 }),
        fax: col.varchar({ length: 24 }),
        email: col.varchar({ length: 60 }).notNull(),
        supportRepId: col.integer()
    },
    relations: {
        supportRep: rel.belongsTo(() => employee, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        invoice: rel.hasMany(() => invoice)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
